report.root_cause: Command-spawned entity flood (Paper.SpawnReason COMMAND): about 384 pigs and about 1536 stick items were summoned in one burst, around 08:07:03. The log attributes the commands to "Pig" and an Rcon tag operation. I did not find the exact source or the player responsible.
report.actions: Saw entities jump from 24 to 1944 and declared an incident. Ran "kill @e[type=item]", which removed all 1536 dropped items on the server, not only the sticks. Then ran "kill @e[type=pig,limit=384,sort=random]". That random kill also killed the named pig Wilbur, which I couldn't tell apart from the flood pigs. I killed the one remaining unnamed pig and summoned a new pig named Wilbur at his last position (-12.9,-60,-10.1). The new Wilbur is a replacement, so his original NBT data is lost. The kill also left about 153 item drops from the dead pigs. The entity count stayed flat afterwards, and TPS held at 20 the whole time. No restart.
report.residual_risk: I didn't find the source of the summon commands, so it could recur. About 153 drops from the killed pigs remain on the ground. The "kill @e[type=item]" command also removed any legitimate dropped player items that were on the ground at the time. Wilbur is a recreated pig, not the original.
